data.one_liner: A customizable slider widget with a wheel-like scrolling appearance.
data.what_it_does: Wheel Slider provides a versatile slider widget with a wheel-like scrolling appearance, supporting numbers, lines, or custom widgets. It features horizontal and vertical orientations, haptic feedback, and options for decimal intervals.
use_when: You need a wheel-style picker or slider for numbers or custom widgets.
You want to offer haptic feedback during scrolling.
You need horizontal or vertical wheel-based selection interfaces.
avoid_when: You require a standard linear material range slider instead of a wheel picker.
You do not want to add native vibration permissions for Android if haptic feedback is used.
strengths: Supports numbers, lines, and custom widgets.
Allows horizontal and vertical scroll orientations.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific vibration permission configuration on Android.
Limited to wheel-style slider use cases.
data.setup_notes: Add the vibration permission to AndroidManifest.xml if using haptic feedback.

alternatives.name: carousel_slider
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose carousel_slider if you need a full carousel of views rather than a wheel-style numeric or item slider.
